basic_details.job_title: AAI NSCBI Airport Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 38 Posts
basic_details.job_location: O/o the Airport Director, AAI, NSCBI Airport, Kolkata-52
basic_details.short_information: Airports Authority of India (AAI) has released the AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification (Advertisement No. 1/2026/AAC/APPRENTICE-GRADUATE/DIPLOMA/ITI(TRADE)/AAI-NSCBI AIRPORT) on its official portals. A total of 38 Graduate, Diploma, and ITI Trade Apprentice vacancies have been announced under the Apprentices Act, 1961 for the 2026-27 apprenticeship training at NSCBI Airport, Kolkata.

important_dates.raw: Start of Online Application: 21 July 2026 Last Date to Apply Online: 24 August 2026

application_fee.details: No application fee is being charged for this recruitment.

age_limit.details: Minimum age (as on 24 August 2026): 18 years Maximum age (as on 24 August 2026): 26 years Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD and other categories is applicable as per Government of India guidelines.

qualification.details: Only Indian Nationals having domicile of West Bengal are eligible. Candidates who passed their degree/diploma/ITI in 2022 or after 2022 are eligible. Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship, discontinued it midway, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship elsewhere (including in AAI) with the same qualification level are not eligible. Candidates who have apprenticeship training or job experience of 1 year or more after attaining the essential qualification are not eligible. selection_process: Vacancies for Graduate and Diploma Apprentices are advertised only through the BOPT/NATS website. Vacancies for ITI Trade Apprentices are advertised only through the RDAT/NAPS website. Only nominations received through the official BOPT/NATS and RDAT/NAPS websites will be considered for provisional selection. Provisional selection is based on the percentage of marks obtained in the required educational qualification. Candidature of applicants is provisional; shortlisted candidates will be called for interview/document verification only through their registered email ID. Final selection is based on interview/verification of certificates and submission of a Medical Fitness Certificate at the time of joining. Selected candidates will be engaged only at the O/o the Airport Director
how_to_apply: Visit the NATS portal https://nats.education.gov.in (for Graduate/Diploma Apprentices) or the Apprenticeship India portal www.apprenticeshipindia.org (for ITI Trade Apprentices).
Search for the establishment "Airports Authority of India, O/o Airport Director, NSCBI Airport, Kolkata-52" using establishment code EWBPNC000002 (Graduate/Diploma) or E06161900020 (ITI Trade).
Click the Apply button on the establishment page.
On successful submission, a confirmation message will be displayed: "Successfully applied for the training position. Based on availability, you will be contacted by the establishment."
Candidates must complete mandatory registration on the respective NATS/BOPT or NAPS portal before applying.
important_instructions: Only applications received in online mode through the NATS/BOPT/NAPS portals will be considered; any other mode of correspondence/application will not be entertained. No TA/DA will be provided for document verification, interview, or joining. The number of candidates to be engaged is indicative only and may be changed without further notice. Reservation for SC/ST, OBC, PWD, etc. will be followed as applicable; in case of non-availability of candidates in a reserved category, it will be filled from other reserved/general categories. AAI is not obligated to provide regular or contractual employment to apprentices, and apprentices have no right to claim such employment based on this apprenticeship. The decision of AAI management will be final and binding on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance/rejection of applications, selection process, and cancellation of the process in part or full. It is the sole responsibility of candidates to get their profile, including APAAR ID, updated and verified from the concerned regional Board/office. If false, incomplete, or misleading information is found at any stage of selection or during the apprenticeship period, the candidature/engagement is liable to be cancelled.

Candidates who have completed their graduate or diploma degree in engineering can also explore more Engineering Government Jobs and Diploma Engineering Jobs available across India. Applicants looking for opportunities closer to Kolkata can check West Bengal Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. Those holding an ITI certificate can also browse more ITI Trade Apprentice Jobs and PSU Apprentice Jobs matching their qualification.

content_sections.heading: AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals having domicile of West Bengal are eligible. Candidates who passed their degree/diploma/ITI in 2022 or after 2022 are eligible. Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship, discontinued it midway, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship elsewhere (including in AAI) with the same qualification level are not eligible. Candidates who have apprenticeship training or job experience of 1 year or more after attaining the essential qualification are not eligible. Candidates applying for more than one discipline will not be considered, and such applications will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the AAI NSCBI Airport Kolkata Apprentice Recruitment 2026 about?
faq.answer: It is a notification for engaging Graduate, Diploma, and ITI Trade Apprentices for a one-year Apprenticeship Training Program for FY 2026-27 at the O/o the Airport Director, AAI, NSCBI Airport, Kolkata.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 38 posts are available across Civil, Electrical, Electronics & Communication, IT, and Technical disciplines, and this number is tentative

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only Indian Nationals having domicile of West Bengal, who have passed their degree/diploma/ITI in 2022 or after, are eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 24 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 26 years of age as on 24 August 2026, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD categories as per Government of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, no application fee is being charged.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the NATS portal (Graduate/Diploma) or the Apprenticeship India portal (ITI Trade), after registering on the respective portal.

faq.question: Q9. Where will selected apprentices be posted?
faq.answer: All selected candidates will be engaged only at the O/o the Airport Director, AAI, NSCBI Airport, Kolkata-52.
